'''Nightdevils''' were endangered, [[Sentience/Legends|semi-sentient]] mountain predators native to [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]]. They ate [[clawcat]]s and other creatures.<ref name="SotE">''[[Goroth: Slave of the Empire]]''</ref>
